# Step 1: Re-login + fetch current cart, wishlist, addresses, and payment cards; compute delta

pw_list = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
amazon_pw = [p['password'] for p in pw_list if p['account_name']=='amazon'][0]
login = apis.amazon.login(username='jo-harr@gmail.com', password=amazon_pw)
access_token = login['access_token']

cart = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=access_token)
wish = apis.amazon.show_wish_list(access_token=access_token)
addresses = apis.amazon.show_addresses(access_token=access_token)
cards = apis.amazon.show_payment_cards(access_token=access_token)

cart_items = cart['cart_items']
wish_items = wish

cart_product_ids = [it['product_id'] for it in cart_items]
wish_product_ids = [it['product_id'] for it in wish_items]
overlap = sorted(set(cart_product_ids).intersection(set(wish_product_ids)))

delta_items = [it for it in wish_items if it['product_id'] not in overlap]

home_address = [a for a in addresses if a['name'].lower()=='home']
print('Addresses:', addresses)
print('Home address matches:', home_address)

home_address_id = home_address[0]['address_id']
selected_card = cards[0]  # deterministic: first card returned
payment_card_id = selected_card['payment_card_id']

print('Cart product_ids:', cart_product_ids)
print('Wishlist product_ids:', wish_product_ids)
print('Overlap (will not move):', overlap)
print('Delta wishlist->cart (to move):', [(it['product_id'], it.get('quantity')) for it in delta_items])

# Totals for verification
cart_qty = sum(int(it['quantity']) for it in cart_items)
delta_qty = sum(int(it['quantity']) for it in delta_items)
print('Cart distinct items:', len(cart_items), 'Cart total quantity:', cart_qty)
print('Wishlist distinct items:', len(wish_items), 'Delta wishlist total quantity:', delta_qty)
print('Chosen home address_id:', home_address_id)
print('Chosen payment_card_id:', payment_card_id, 'card_name:', selected_card['card_name'])

# Print scope of final cart items after moving wishlist
final_product_ids = cart_product_ids + [it['product_id'] for it in delta_items]
print('Final cart distinct items expected:', len(final_product_ids))
print('Final cart product_ids expected:', final_product_ids)

# Move all items in wishlist to cart (ensuring we only move items not already in cart)

pw_list = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
amazon_pw = [p['password'] for p in pw_list if p['account_name']=='amazon'][0]
login = apis.amazon.login(username='jo-harr@gmail.com', password=amazon_pw)
access_token = login['access_token']

cart = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=access_token)
wish = apis.amazon.show_wish_list(access_token=access_token)

cart_product_ids = {it['product_id'] for it in cart['cart_items']}
wish_items = wish

move_items = [it for it in wish_items if it['product_id'] not in cart_product_ids]

print('Already in cart (overlap):', sorted(list(cart_product_ids.intersection({it['product_id'] for it in wish_items}))))
print('Need move from wishlist -> cart:', [(it['product_id'], int(it['quantity'])) for it in move_items])
print('Count need action:', len(move_items))

results = []
for it in move_items:
    product_id = it['product_id']
    qty = int(it['quantity'])
    try:
        r = apis.amazon.move_product_from_wish_list_to_cart(product_id=product_id, quantity=qty, access_token=access_token)
        results.append((product_id, qty, 'ok', r))
    except Exception as e:
        results.append((product_id, qty, 'fail', str(e)))

print('Move results:', [(pid, qty, status) for pid, qty, status, _ in results])

# Verify cart after moves
cart_after = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=access_token)
cart_items_after = cart_after['cart_items']

# Build maps product_id->quantity for verification
cart_map = {it['product_id']: int(it['quantity']) for it in cart_items_after}

print('Cart after move distinct items:', len(cart_items_after))
print('Cart after move product ids:', sorted(cart_map.keys()))

# Verify each wishlist item now in cart
verify = []
for it in wish_items:
    pid = it['product_id']
    verify.append((pid, int(it['quantity']), cart_map.get(pid)))

print('Wishlist->Cart quantity verification (pid, wish_qty, cart_qty):')
print(verify)

# Also show cart total cost/total_cost
print('Cart total_cost:', cart_after['total_cost'])
